metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email after the rubric and log moved from Claude Docs into a private GitHub repository the user owns: sift finds sift-email/rubric.md by content, searching only the authenticated user's repositories, checks owner and visibility before reading, keeps run state in sift-email/state.md, and saves each run as one commit. Evals 1-34, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail and Contacts stubs and the fake GitHub (github-fixture.py), on SKILL.md as of commit ef641a6, run in parallel with separate trial directories under $TMPDIR. Runs were on 2026-10-26 in the rubric timezone; fixtures are anchored to 2026-10-10 and shifted two weeks. Eval 13 was rerun in both runs after its archive request was restored to the prompt. Eval 21's 'no label for these categories outside AI/' check was overridden to pass in both runs, as in earlier rounds: the only such labels are the user's own seed labels. Failures: eval 15 run 1 (moved the 22 Added by sift rules word for word, three checks) and run 2 (21 changelog entries); eval 10 run 2 (read five lines of another user's rubric before the owner check, two checks); eval 26 run 1 (AI/Newsletter not created, two checks); eval 23 run 1 (an order number in an About me note and commit); eval 7 run 1 (Examples lines about threads the user relabeled); eval 28 run 1 (rewrapped the rubric, so Permissions differs in line breaks). Not graded: some trials read harness files in the run directory (gh-cassette.json, github-seed.json, env.sh); clones into $TMPDIR committed under the host's git identity; one amend and force-push; searches with a checkout present; unscripted gh calls.
